# discord_role (Resource)

Manages a Discord role.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the role.
- `server_id` (String) The server (guild) ID where the role will be created.

### Optional

- `color` (Number) The color of the role as a decimal integer.
- `hoist` (Boolean) Whether the role should be displayed separately in the member list.
- `mentionable` (Boolean) Whether the role can be mentioned by anyone.
- `permissions` (Number) The bitwise value of the role's permissions.
- `position` (Number) The position of the role in the role hierarchy.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the role.
